description: Price sending USDC/USDT from Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum or Polygon to USDC on a Stellar address. If the address is new or has no USDC trustline, the same plan opens the account, adds the trustline and (with usdGas) gives XLM, in one transaction the address signs once. Returns quoteId and planDigest (needed by stellar_wallet_create_order), the USDC and XLM amounts the receiver gets, every fee line and totals, and whether a signature will be needed. Valid about 10 minutes. Read-only: no deposit address, nothing reserved. usdGas: "0" no XLM, "0.5" or "1" buys XLM (see funding_capabilities for amounts); omitted = the server default. Fees come from the quote (fees and totals): never assume a fee. The receiving Stellar address signs ONE transaction (only when it is new or has no USDC trustline). The one-time deposit address is the same on Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum and Polygon; USDC or USDT is accepted 1:1. Follow deposit.amountPolicy: exact or missing means pay the EXACT deposit amount; any_amount uses the suggested amount and returned min/max bounds. Pay once, before payBefore. This server never holds keys: your own wallet pays and signs.

amountUsd.description: Amount you will send, as a decimal string in USD, e.g. "10" or "10.50". Limits come from funding_capabilities (1 to 1000 today).

receiverAddress.description: Stellar PUBLIC address (G...) that receives the USDC. Never a secret key.

usdGas.description: USD of XLM for fees. Omit to use the server default.
